title: Khwarazm, on the far northern edge of the empire… | Folio 7 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
Khwarazm, on the far northern edge of the empire. An old general who has served three rulers is still alive. Somewhere on the road from the sultan's court, a secret order is travelling toward him. Its purpose is to have him killed.

The full story: Folio 7: The Secret Order Against the Loyal General — on our channel and on every podcast app.
